fields.summary_ko.0: GF Securities analyst Evan Lee lowered Dell Technologies (DELL) price target to $341 and maintained 'Hold' rating, with DELL down more than 45% from year-to-date highs.
fields.summary_ko.1: GF expects fiscal 2027 enterprise server shipments to decline 9%, citing intensifying AI business competition due to weak PC shipments and loss of SpaceX VR200 orders to Hon Hai.
fields.summary_ko.2: Despite GF's next quarter revenue estimate of $5.4 billion and EPS of $7.18, Wall Street consensus still maintains 'Strong Buy' rating with average price target of $587.
